title: Choose the right software for Pillar 2 Top-up Taxes
text:
Domestic Top-up Tax and Multinational Top-up Tax apply a global minimum corporate tax rate of 15% to the largest corporate groups.

 These taxes apply to accounting periods beginning on or after 31 December 2023.

 HMRC cannot recommend one product or service over another. If you have problems using your chosen software, you’ll need to contact your software provider.

 Before you choose your software

 You should  check if you need to report Pillar 2 Top-up Taxes .

 If you’re acting on behalf of a client you’ll need to make sure you have access to Pillar 2 Top-up Taxes as an agent .
